skills.name: Flowing Radiance (流明)
skills.description: SP Oitsukigami directs overflowing golden glimmer to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125% and has a 50% chance of decreasing the enemy's onibi bar by 1 (does not effect monsters).

skills.name: Glamour Dance (綺羅舞)
skills.line: Step out of the dark and into the light.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
A dance under the moon to close the curtain. At the end of SP Oitsukigami's turn, fills up the onibi bar by an additional 3 bars and grants 2 stacks of Moonshine to all allies. When your onibi overflow, and she is not inflicted with any control effects or effects such as Banish, grants 1 stack of Moonshine to all allies for each 1 overflowed onibi (does not trigger when her Moonshine stacks are at max). ; Moonshine (照君) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 10 stacks. Each stack increases ATK by 5%. ; Glittering Light (流光) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Each stack increases RES by 10%.

upgrades.text: '''Upper Hand''': Automatically fills up the onibi bar by an additional 4 bars at the start of battle.
At the start of an ally's turn, and if you have less than 3 onibi, immediately fills up the onibi bar by 1 at the cost of 1 Glittering Light stack (cannot trigger if she has no stacks).

skills.name: Flying Radiance (飛彩凝輝)
skills.line: I wonder how many people have flown to the moon and back.
skills.description: SP Oitsukigami dances with light steps to invoke the bright light. Grants Gathered Glimmer to all non-summoned allies, sustained for 1 turn. At the start of battle and at the end of turn, she gains 3 stacks of Glittering Light. ; Gathered Glimmer (集落光) : :'''Buff, Mark''': When an onibi is removed from you, consumes this mark to fill up the onibi bar by the amount of onibi removed. Also inflicts Radiance Lost on the enemy at the top of the move bar, lasts for 1 turn. Removes 1 stack of Glittering Light after this effect is triggered. Cannot trigger when she has less than 1 Glittering Light stack. ; Glittering Light (流光) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Each stack increases RES by 10%. ; Radiance Lost (失彩) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Onibi bar cannot be filled up at the end of turn.

upgrades.text: If Gathered Glimmer is not consumed, dispels 1 control effect or debuff from self when its duration ends.
Duration for Lost Splendour increases to 2 turns.
If Gathered Glimmer is not consumed, increases allies' ATK by 30% and SPD by 30 when its duration ends, lasts for 2 turns.

bio.condition: With SP Oitsukigami win 10 times in against Oitsukigami.
